tools.name: list_supported_countries
tools.description: Countries FaxUp can send faxes to, with their calling codes. Read-only.

tools.name: get_price_quote
tools.description: What a fax costs on FaxUp, optionally for a given fax number and page count. Checks the number can be faxed (country served, not a mobile line). Read-only; charges nothing.

tools.name: send_fax
tools.description: Prepares a fax of a PDF to a fax number and returns a confirmation link. The fax is NOT sent and nothing is charged until the person opens the link, checks the pages and number, pays or uses their FaxUp credits, and presses Send on faxup.net. Give the PDF as file_url (public https link) or file_base

tools.name: get_fax_status
tools.description: Status of a fax prepared with send_fax: awaiting_confirmation, opened, handed_off (taken to faxup.net to send), cancelled, or expired; once the person has sent it on FaxUp, its delivery (sending, delivered or failed). Read-only.
